text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0827 CDT.

CANOLA - C$1.00 to C$2.00 higher on less than expected rain in the U.S. growing regions with little rain seen on the weekend. Participants were expected to cover shorts ahead of the weekend. Crushers were likely to continue buying August, September and November. November WCE canola crush profit margins fell to -6.48 Thursday from -6.06 Wednesday. Canada's dollar opened flat at C$1.3760, rose to 84.32 yen and rose to 1.3058 marks.
FLAXSEED - C$0.50 to C$1.00 up on spill-over support.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne higher, watching U.S. markets and weekend weather forecasts.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on less than expected rain in the U.S.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
